heading: Who may act for you
sub: An application or a person you name here may ask this service for a token in your name by exchanging one of yours (RFC 8693 token exchange). Every access token issued about you says so in its may_act claim, and an exchange of one by anybody ELSE is refused. You may name one party.
currentPerson: The party who may act for you is {dn} (a person).
currentApplication: The party who may act for you is {dn} (an application).
currentStale: The party who may act for you is {dn} — which names nothing in this directory now, so your tokens carry no may_act.
nobody: You have named nobody. Your access tokens carry no may_act claim.
notDelegated: An administrator has marked your account as one that cannot be delegated, so nobody may act for you whatever you name here.
name: Name them
searchSub: Type at least three characters of their username (uid). The search runs when you stop typing for three seconds, or at once when you press Enter. It finds only people of this realm whose accounts were created here — not ones a federation partner or a social sign-in created — and never you or a disabled account.
searchTooShort: Type at least {min} characters of a username to search.
searchFailed: The directory could not be searched just now. Try again, or type their DN below.
searchNone: Nobody here has a username containing {q}.
searchMore: More people matched than are shown here. Type more of the username to narrow the search.
